Answer: C
Reason: The CT images (Figures 4a and 4b) clearly show hyperdense, radiopaque material within the pulmonary arteries, which is pathognomonic for polymethylmethacrylate (cement) embolism following vertebroplasty. This complication explains the intraoperative drop in end-tidal CO2 due to acute pulmonary vascular obstruction and matches the description in option C.
